profile.headline: Popeye’s influencer and Elden Lord
profile.summary:
I'm a trained musician with a passion for technology! The advent of computers, mobile phones, and connected technology has reshaped our society in unimaginable ways over the past few decades, and I can only imagine how much higher we will fly.  

MM: Conducting
Shenandoah Conservatory

BA: Vocal Performance, minor in Composition, Theatre, and Bassoon Performance
The Dana School of Music 


I always enjoy speaking with like-minded individuals.  If this sounds like you, please feel free to contact me via InMail!

positions.title: Software Engineer - Fastlane
positions.description: Skills: TypeScript · Claude · JavaScript · Node.js · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer - Braintree Web SDK
positions.description:
o Collaborated cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate complex payment needs into user-friendly web experiences.
o Designed responsive and scalable components, ensuring robust performance across various browsers and devices.
o Optimized SDKs for performance, security, and compatibility with industry-leading standards and evolving web technologies.
o Engaged in rigorous testing, debugging, and refactoring of code to deliver reliable and seamless integrations for global merchant partners.
o Acted as a technical advocate, providing thorough documentation and guidance to developers implementing the SDK.
o Demonstrated a commitment to improving developer workflows by enhancing APIs and improving user experience based on community feedback.
o Contributed to a culture of innovation and collaboration, regularly brainstorming enhancements for the Braintree ecosystem.

positions.title: Vault Migrations Engineer - Braintree
positions.description:
o	Specialized in merchant migrations—both performing migrations in a command line
environment and maintaining/improving the tools used for migrations
o	Maintained a custom Tampermonkey enhancement suite, built in Javascript, to enhance and
streamline fellow employees’ experience
o	Created an internal risk evaluation tool, built in Ruby on Rails, that leverages the MasterCard
MATCH API and the OFAC databases

positions.title: Merchant Support Specialist - Braintree
positions.description:
o	Managed relationships with merchants worldwide
o	Piloted new Salesforce versions and assisted with teamwide transition
o	Implemented teamwide Zendesk macros
o	Moderated internal support channels to provide live feedback and act as a subject matter expert
o	Managed relationship with EMEA business partners

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist - Venmo
positions.description:
o	Recognized as a top performer while at Venmo
o	Helped open a new international PayPal/Venmo office by training new teams, creating and presenting training materials, and directly working with Venmo Leadership to identify trends and areas of opportunities
o	Moderated internal support channels to provide live feedback and act as a subject matter expert

positions.title: Business Development Representative
positions.description: Connecting enterprise executives with RCG's team of data/analytics consultants and developers to collaborate on advanced analytics implementation strategies and business application endeavors.

positions.title: Business Development Representative
positions.description:
o	Assisted IT support staff for BDRs and Management
o	Sourced and developed leads for business development 
o	Salesforce administration and development 
o	Microsoft Dynamics CRM reporting
o	Tracked and reported team members' KPIs

positions.title: Lead Development Representative
positions.description:
o	Developed and sourced leads for business development
o	Salesforce administration and development
o	Tracked and reported team members' KPIs

positions.title: Mobile Sales Consultant
positions.description:
o	Provided personalized service and exceptional expertise for customers. 
o	Handled all aspects of the sale including: customer contracts and warranties, customer payments, cash and credit card/check transactions. 
o	Developed, maintained and communicated strong, up-to-date knowledge of wireless products, accessories, pricing plans and service features.
o	 Specialized in resolution of advanced wireless contract issues and customer retention.
